 Geneva10 

Sep 01, 2026, 08:34 ET

Mayor and Kenosha County Executive to join company and community leaders in marking the milestone expansion

KENOSHA, Wis., Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- G10 Fulfillment, a North American third-party logistics and fulfillment provider, will hold a ribbon-cutting ceremony celebrating the grand opening of its new distribution facility in Kenosha, Wisconsin, on Thursday, September 10, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. at 12345 38th Street.

The new 315,000-square-foot facility replaces G10's former Twin Lakes location and more than doubles the company's Midwest warehouse capacity. Positioned along the Chicago–Milwaukee freight corridor, the site supports large-scale order fulfillment and regional inventory distribution as part of G10's broader logistics network.

# Wagner Logistics to Add Nearly 80 Jobs with New High-Volume Logistics Operation in Liberty

 Wagner Logistics 

Oct 14, 2026, 08:54 ET

NORTH KANSAS CITY, Mo., Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Wagner Logistics, a nationwide provider of third-party logistics, today announced it has signed a multi-year agreement with a Kansas City-area manufacturer to launch a new manufacturing support and warehouse operations program in Liberty, Mo.

The new operation includes two leased warehouse facilities in the Liberty area totaling more than 830,000 square feet. Wagner expects to add 79 new local jobs over the next two years, starting immediately. The company will also make a multi-million-dollar investment in equipment, infrastructure and automated trailer loading and unloading technology to support the operation.

"This is exactly the kind of operation where Wagner's strengths come through," said Brian Smith, President and Chief Executive Officer of Wagner Logistics. "It requires speed, flexibility, close coordination and the ability to design a solution around what the customer actually needs."

Flexport has opened its first fully automated fulfillment center just outside Chicago. The company says more than 350 robots at the facility double the efficiency compared with a traditional warehouse. The center offers four times the storage and helps deliver 99.9% order accuracy. Kroger opened the site in 2022 as a robotic grocery fulfillment center built with Ocado. It announced last November that it would shut the center along with two other Ocado sites, expecting the closures to improve e-commerce operating profit by $400 million in 2026.
